direction_policy: Estimate-absence transitions take precedence: numeric to absent RESULT_REMOVED; absent to numeric RESULT_ADDED; both absent NO_DIRECTION even if candidate k changes. For two numerical results, AWAY_FROM_NULL takes priority if any of larger absolute effect (absolute log ratio or absolute MD), narrower comparable CI, more favourable point, or newly favourable CI applies.
